name: analyze-issue
objective: Analyze the issue and locate affected repository areas.

name: build-implementation-plan
objective: Build an implementation plan grounded in repository documentation.

name: generate-patch
objective: Generate a scoped patch from the implementation plan.

name: run-validation
objective: Run deterministic build and test validation for the patch.

name: evaluate-acceptance
objective: Evaluate prior evidence against issue acceptance criteria.

name: create-pull-request
objective: Create a pull request from accepted implementation evidence.
